title: sync
description: Result of `stride sync`. Counts are activities touched in the rolling window; `pruned` are rows Strava no longer returns.

streams_fetched.description: stream rows STORED this run. Not the number of reads spent: a read whose body will not decode stores nothing and is counted in streams_skipped instead

streams_skipped.description: reads whose body would not decode as UTF-8. Nothing was stored, so these stay pending and retry next sync. A value that repeats across syncs means the data is unreadable rather than merely late
